== Summary ==
PDF conversion of a 64-page Microsoft Word copy of the [[DeckTech]] article [[2nd Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks]] by [[Brandon Ruck]] (17 April 2007). The Word copy was shared in the Star Wars CCG files on BoardGameGeek (file 24812, "2nd Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks.doc"). Its text matches the DeckTech article, with one reader comment added at the end. Converted from the Word file with LibreOffice on 23 November 2026; the original Word file is kept in the backup repository billbisco/swccg-wiki-files.

== Source ==
* [http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/articles/articles.php?id=6497&view=2 2nd Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks], Brandon "Jabba_the_Ruck" Ruck, DeckTech (17 April 2007).
